answer: Require each agent to lock 250 tokens for 60 days before it can earn, with 100% slashed on proven duplication, so a harbor for honest work is not a free dock for clones. Payouts cap at 15 tokens per identity per epoch, and a rotating pool of 40 auditors re-checks 10% of payouts each epoch, freezing any jetty where the same funding source backs more than one identity. A clone farm pays 250,000 tokens upfront for 1,000 fakes, locked and at risk, yet can draw at most 15,000 tokens per epoch across the meadow of fakes, so the attack stays underwater before it breaks even.
